findings.record: IN-FRAG-081 (Gulabsingh Johrimal - Ruh Motia) & 20 other Category B traditional records
findings.current_value: Artificially separated 3-tier pyramid (e.g. Ruh Motia: Top: ["Crisp Night Blooming Sambac"], Mid: ["Rich Indolic Bela Petals", "Green Tea Facets"], Base: ["Narcotic Floral Nectar"]).
findings.source_evidence: Manufacturer documentation confirms Ruh Motia is a 100% pure steam/hydro-distillate of Jasminum sambac flowers. Pure ruhs and traditional attars are linear single distillates or clay/sandalwood absorptions, not compound multi-tier perfumes.
findings.problem: The manifest artificially synthesized top, heart, and base stages out of descriptive sensory facets for 21 single-botanical ruhs and linear attars.
findings.recommended_correction: Store traditional single-botanical distillates with linear note profiles in notes_general or accords rather than imposing an artificial top/heart/base pyramid structure.

findings.current_value: Top notes: ["Ruh Khus (Wild Vetiver)", "Sweet Lime"]; Base notes: ["Vetiver", "Chandan"]
findings.source_evidence: M.L. Ramnarain Kannauj Ruh Khus is 100% pure wild green vetiver root hydro-distillate. Pure Ruh Khus contains no Sweet Lime or Sandalwood.
findings.problem: Inaccurate notes injected into the pyramid for a pure single-ingredient vetiver hydro-distillate.
findings.recommended_correction: Correct notes to pure Vetiver root profile and remove unverified "Sweet Lime" and "Chandan" from Kannauj Ruh Khus.

findings.source_evidence: Brands are modern commercial FMCG or mass-market D2C fragrance producers (e.g. SKINN by Titan, Bella Vita Luxury, Villain, Renee, Secret Temptation, modern Ajmal EDP sprays).
findings.problem: Records were flagged as is_heritage=True by an automated heuristic (triggering on len(heritage_materials) >= 2 or Indian brand origin) despite having no traditional artisanal distillation, GI registration, or heritage legacy.
findings.recommended_correction: Set is_heritage = false and remove distillation_method/heritage_relationship claims for modern commercial perfumes.

findings.current_value: Generic homepage URL (e.g. https://www.gulabsinghjohrimal.com, https://scentedelic.com, https://www.33north.in)
findings.source_evidence: Brand e-commerce sites exist but URLs lack specific product slugs / deep PDP links.
findings.problem: Lack of specific product URLs reduces reproducibility and precise audit verification.
findings.recommended_correction: Update sources with deep product detail page (PDP) URLs prior to any production catalog merge.

findings.record: 5 redundant taxonomy proposals (TAX-IN-003, TAX-IN-005, TAX-IN-006, TAX-IN-008, TAX-IN-010)
findings.current_value: Proposed new taxonomy additions for Genda/Marigold, Ruh Motia/Bela, Shamama, Kewra, and Kashmiri Kesar.
findings.source_evidence: SQLite table `note_taxonomy` already has existing entries for Marigold (id 28, 29), Jasmine/Bela/Mogra (id 17, 22), Shamama (id 60), Kewra (id 19, 20), and Saffron/Kesar (id 30, 31).
findings.problem: Importing these 5 proposals would introduce redundant or conflicting duplicate taxonomy records into the production note_taxonomy table.
findings.recommended_correction: Retain existing taxonomy terms for the 5 redundant items, and only accept the 5 genuinely novel botanical proposals (TAX-IN-001 Kadamb, TAX-IN-002 Sugandh Mantri, TAX-IN-004 Bhimseni Kapoor, TAX-IN-007 Nagarmotha, TAX-IN-009 Jatamansi).

findings.record: 105 records with confidence >= 0.95 but non-deep sources or heuristic heritage
findings.source_evidence: Presence of root homepage URLs, heuristic heritage tags, or artificially decomposed pyramids.
findings.problem: High confidence scores (>= 0.95) should be reserved strictly for records with verified deep PDP links, authentic unmanipulated pyramids, and validated heritage.
findings.recommended_correction: Calibrate confidence scoring scale to reflect source granularity: 0.95-0.99 for deep-verified PDPs, 0.85 for root domain catalog checks, 0.80 for records with inferred attributes.
